metadata.note: geo_point uses GeoJSON [longitude, latitude] format. Cameroon approximate bounds: lon 8.5–16.5, lat 1.7–13.5. Bonaberi area (Douala) is the primary hub for LPG filling operations.

site_functions.CENTREEMPLISSEUR: Filling centre — bulk LPG is filled into tanker trucks and cylinder bundles here
site_functions.ENTREPOT: Storage depot — holds LPG reserves; may also supply POINTAPPROVISIONABLE sites
site_functions.POINTAPPROVISIONABLE: Supply point — receives deliveries from filling centres; serves as last-mile distribution point
